known.via: English Wikipedia "Barbanza e Iria" (a wine place on Wikidata)

blurb.text: A Galician vino de la tierra covering municipalities in A Coruña and Pontevedra provinces, such as Padrón, Boiro and Ribeira. It sits one step below the DO level and gained that status in 2007.
